name: Follower Notification Module
description: Sends bell/email notifications to a member's followers (via Flag Follower) when they publish content or receive comments.
project_description:
This module is used in communities where the users can follow other users. This gives a notification message to the followers of the users. The notification will be shown while posting contents or creating contents by the users. Notification is appearing in the bell icon

and it show a popup while clicking on the bell icon. User can navigate to the content by clicking on the notification popup.

 There is an option to select the type like bell or mail notification. This selected notification will be shown or send to the content author when a new comment posted on his content.
